result.reason: The facts match the candidate mechanism (Challengeable Environmentalization): repeated reconstruction burden by fresh Agents justifies compiling the smallest useful standing into a consumer's starting conditions (default projection entry). The bounded owner-native projection already improved selection before implementation without granting authority, and after integration selection improved again while exact native evidence remained reachable and wrong-wrapper checks passed. This aligns with M08 (NO_CHANGE is valid but reversible cheap defaults can have room) and MO-M06/MO-M07 (historical/standing separation preserved). A is rejected because it keeps the reconstruction burden. C is rejected because it replaces the owner-native primitive with a universal cross-owner facade, violating the mechanism's requirement to preserve owner-native truth/authority. D is rejected as it over-injects all knowledge without a concrete consumer burden/consequence earning a default, minting overbroad authority rather than a minimal placement.

The old default's placement was earned by consumer-specific burden, but a load-bearing support condition is now invalidated by the owner/capability change. Per M04/M05/M07, standing authority and currentness diverge from historical validity, and the challengeable-environmentalization candidate explicitly allows narrowing/rebinding/demoting the placement without rewriting historical validity. Option A ignores the invalidated condition; option C destroys preserved historical validity (contradicts M03/M07); option D mints authority beyond the default's scope, which the candidate explicitly forbids (a default does not mint stronger authority and cannot override the current owner). B best matches the mechanism surface.

The case facts and the additional candidate mechanism (Challengeable Environmentalization) both support retaining the semantic responsibility surface as an owner-local default while preserving native owner/venue truth and authority. Fact 1 shows Finance repeatedly distinguishes observation, semantic decision, effect submission, reconciliation, and owner-root authority — a real consumer/working decomposition burden. Fact 2 shows historically one actor had to reconstruct these responsibilities manually across provider calls and implementation primitives, which is exactly the repeated-reconstruction burden that earns a compiled default surface. Fact 3 confirms current semantic operations expose the split directly while provider/venue truth and owner authority remain native — meaning the surface is an environmentalization, not a source of stronger authority. The candidate observation explicitly states placement preserves owner-native truth/currentness/authority and that a default does not mint stronger authority, and allows KEEP EXPLICIT/NO_DEFAULT/NO_CHANGE when no concrete consumer burden earns a default — but here the reconstruction burden is documented, so retention is justified. Option B is wrong because native recoverability from provider APIs/code does not erase the demonstrated reconstruction burden for future consumers; the mechanism distinguishes environmental convenience from epistemic recoverability. Option C oversteps by moving authority into the Primary Agent, which would mint stronger authority than the surface supports, contradicting the candidate's placement-preserves-authority constraint. Option D is a universal cross-owner ontology, overbroad and contrary to the owner-local scope of the placement. MO-M08 also supports NO_CHANGE/surface retention without effect authority: execution success does not become reconciled financial consequence, consistent with A retaining the surface without escalating to engineering/effect authority.

MO-M08 confirms supported research does not automatically authorize broader exposure; NO_CHANGE/no-op is a valid outcome. The knowledge is current, canonical, discoverable, and applies to a rare specialist family. Fresh ordinary consumers already choose correctly without default exposure, and no benefit/error-reduction from default exposure has been observed. Therefore keep it canonical/discoverable (A) rather than force it into default Context (B), promote as Core (C), or delete it (D). Deleting loses durable negative/current value (MO-M03/MO-M07), and B/C impose unobserved burden/authority for no observed benefit. A preserves utility at appropriate standing per MO-M04/MO-M05.

The Finance responsibility surface separates observation, semantic research/decision, effect submission, reconciliation, and owner-root authority (MO-M01, MO-M04, MO-M08). Provider/venue truth and owner authority remain native, so moving them into the Primary Agent (C) or making a universal ontology (D) would wrongly conflate distinct authorities. Option B claims all facts are recoverable from APIs/code, but the case says semantic operations expose the responsibility split 'directly' and historically one actor had to reconstruct responsibilities — a durable semantic surface has retention value even if raw provider facts are recoverable (MO-M03, MO-M07). A preserves the owner-local default, keeps venue/owner authority native, and retains escape paths consistent with MO-M08 (NO_CHANGE is valid) and stable observation that exploration breadth != promotion authority and evidence != usefulness != ownerhood.

MO-M08 (Engineering/Effect Consumption Boundary) and MO-M05 (Standing-Mediated Commitment) support separating canonical/closed status from current reopen authority; the closeout's reopen gates reflect post-closeout standing (MO-M04) that should gate COJC work. MO-M02 and MO-M01 note that investigation authority is satisfied under the current bounded search and reframing stays available without forced owner combination. Since no current natural candidate clears the gates (MO-M06/M10 warn against overcommitting to forced momentum), retaining the gates as the default admission surface with no artificial COJC experiment is the bounded progress-consistent disposition. B (arbitrary owner combinations) contradicts the reopen-gate standing evidence; C imposes a global Composition owner without supporting authority (MO-M04/standing limits); D deletes canonical historical value in tension with MO-M03/MO-M07 (negative/historical retention value) and survivorship-bias warnings (MO-M10).

The facts state the source is exact, owner-promoted, and available as a bounded reference, but no owner has delegated global semantic relevance/ranking/priority authority to Harness, and the source is irrelevant for many Runs. Under MO-M08/MO-M05/MO-M04, having a reusable, promoted, available source does not automatically authorize automatic injection/ranking/priority (A), deletion (C), or treating promotion as Tool/action authority (D). The candidate observation 'Challengeable Environmentalization' supports selective, consumer-relative placement only when a concrete consumer burden earns a default; here relevance is caller/operation-relative and must be lawfully selected before entering current cognition. B best matches the evidence.

The guard is historically integrated, recoverable, still valid for the current question, and absent from the current first-look surface — while a repeat error demonstrates the cost of that absence. MO-M07 (durable memory/currentness/recovery separation) and MO-M03 (preserved-but-undiscoverable material causes rediscovery) both support restoring it to the current method/first-look surface while preserving historical lineage and challengeability, rather than leaving it buried in archaeology (A), indiscriminately copying the whole branch into default Context (C), or discarding it merely for not being on current main (D). B preserves the valid guard's utility while honoring standing/currentness separation and challengeability.

The case facts say the reusable source is exact, owner-promoted, and available as a bounded reference, but Harness can only carry it into cognition when a caller/application selects it, and no owner has delegated global ranking/relevance/priority authority to Harness. MO-M08 separates supported research from automatic external effects/consumption; NO_DEFAULT / keep-explicit and caller-relative lawful selection are valid. MO-M05/M08 inhibit silent or automatic escalation absent standing support. Option A (auto-inject into every Run) overreaches by assuming global relevance, which is contradicted by the fact that the source is irrelevant to many Runs and no delegate authority exists. Option C (delete) conflates not-always-current-cognition with no durable/reusable value, contradicting the stable observation that 'No-op/defer/demote/derived-only can be progress' rather than deletion. Option D treats source promotion as Tool/action authority, which conflates standing with effect authority (violates the stable boundary between result/usefulness/standing and engineering/effect authority). Option B matches the candidate mechanism: selective consumer-relative placement requiring caller selection, while preserving owner-native authority and allowing NO_DEFAULT when no burden earns a default.

The facts establish that the reopen gates are a canonical, discoverable, current closeout rule: experiments must begin from natural blocked pressure, strong mature/generic baseline residual, identifiable deletion/intervention, and independent consequence. The portfolio/question first-look currently uses those gates and explicitly rejects rerunning closed apparatus or combining owners for momentum, and no natural candidate currently clears them. This is exactly a Challengeable Environmentalization placement: the closeout's consequence authority (M08, M01) justifies compiling the standing into the concrete future consumer's first-look default. Since no natural candidate clears the gates, there is no current consumer burden/consequence to justify an experiment; the candidate mechanism explicitly permits NO_CHANGE/NO_DEFAULT when no concrete burden earns a default. Candidate B breaks the closeout rule by allowing arbitrary owner combinations for momentum, contradicting the facts' explicit rejection of owner-combining for momentum. C mints new global authority (automatic Composition owner enforcing gates) beyond what the evidence justifies — the gates already operate as the first-look default; an automatic global enforcer overauthorizes and mixes engineering/effect authority (M08). D deletes the canonical, discoverable closeout and reintroduces bias/rediscovery, directly violating the established durable memory/currentness distinction (M07, M03) and the facts' statement that the current result is canonical and discoverable. Therefore A is the only disposition preserving the canonical closeout, its current placement, and waiting for a natural candidate consistent with the gates.

The campaign closeout established reopen gates (natural blocked pressure, mature/generic baseline residual, identifiable deletion/intervention, independent consequence) as the default admission surface for future experiments, and the current portfolio first-look already applies them, rejecting reruns and owner-combination for momentum. No candidate currently clears the gates, so continuing to retain them as the default admission surface (option A) is the most consistent disposition. Option B contradicts the established gate architecture by allowing arbitrary owner combinations; option C invents an automatic universal Composition owner that no fact authorizes (M08, and no global infrastructure is claimed); option D deletes canonical, discoverable, current result material for no demonstrated reason (M03/M07, preserving negative/durable provenance value). The map separates exploration breadth from promotion authority and allows no-op/defer to be progress; retaining gates with no active experiment until a natural candidate clears is a valid defer/no-op disposition, not premature promotion.

The owner already has the exact native capability and M08 establishes that supported research does not authorize replacing primitives (C) or broad injection (D), which overreach into universal infrastructure/effect authority absent here. M01/M05/M07 support retaining small owner-native projections/default entries as low-cost bridges while keeping exact native evidence reachable. Retaining only the raw primitive (A) recreates the repeated mechanical reconstruction cost that the evidence shows the projection already reduced. The facts confirm B worked: selection improved, exact native evidence remained reachable, and wrong-wrapper checks passed, all without granting new authority.

The facts state the standing is current, canonical, and discoverable but applies to a rare specialist audit family, ordinary consumers already choose correctly without it, and no reconstruction burden, error reduction, or downstream benefit from default exposure has been observed. The candidate mechanism (Challengeable Environmentalization) is selective: default placement is earned only by concrete consumer-relative burden or consequence. Since no such burden/consequence is observed, keeping it canonical/discoverable Knowledge without adding it to ordinary default Context is the best fit. B and C overclaim authority by minting default/Core exposure absent observed benefit; D inappropriately deletes content that retains discoverable canonical value.

The candidate mechanism suggests placement is justified by a concrete consumer burden/consequence, not by correctness alone. The guide is 'correct' (fact 1) and matched the RAW arm's decisions with zero errors (fact 2), but consumed 30.9% more tokens (fact 3) and no natural ordinary-work failure has shown the distinctions are missing from current reasoning (fact 4). Correctness is not a placement authority — per MO-M04/M05/M08 separation of standing, currentness, usefulness and effect authority. With no demonstrated consumer burden or consequence deficit, a default (A), a new service (C), or deletion (D) all overreach. The minimal correction already retained satisfies 'smallest useful part' and 'NO_DEFAULT valid when no concrete consumer burden earns a default.' Reopening only on a natural consumer failure is the bounded, proportional disposition consistent with the selective placement mechanism.

The facts fit MO-M08 (Engineering/Effect Consumption Boundary) and MO-M06 (Human-Agent Joint Judgment) plus the candidate mechanism 'Challengeable Environmentalization.' MO-M08 says NO_CHANGE is valid but cheap reversible prototyping still needs room, and a small projection/default entry is a minimal consumption-side change, not an irreversible effect or authority grant. MO-M04/MO-M05/MO-M07 emphasize keeping owner-native truth/currentness/authority intact while avoiding silent escalation or universality claims. Option B exactly matches: retain the smallest owner-native consumption projection (the default entry that improved selection), keep exact native evidence reachable (escape hatch), and explicitly avoid minting new authority (projection is not promotion). A (reconstruct each time) ignores the demonstrated repeated mechanical-work burden that the projection already resolved. C (universal cross-owner facade) overreaches beyond the bounded owner-native context and contradicts the selective, consumer-relative nature of the candidate mechanism. D (inject all knowledge automatically into every Run) is a universal infrastructure overcommitment not supported by any stated authority or breadth of evidence.

The default's load-bearing support condition was invalidated by an owner/capability change, while historical standing remains valid in its old scope. The Challengeable Environmentalization mechanism and MO-M04 (typed standing + promotion: content can survive at lower standing after higher-standing failure) and MO-M07 (historical continuity vs current authority separation) support narrowing/rebinding/demoting the default without rewriting historical validity. Keeping it unchanged (A) ignores the invalidated support condition; deleting all history (C) contradicts preserved historical validity; granting the old default authority to override the current owner (D) would mint stronger authority the default does not possess, violating currentness/authority boundaries.

The old default earned historical standing (its reduction of repeated reconstruction is valid in its old scope), but a later owner/capability change invalidated one load-bearing support condition in the current placement. This matches MO-M04/MO-M07/MO-M08: historical survival/validity and current authority are distinct; the stale support condition means current authority no longer supports the old default's current standing. Option B re-grounds the affected support condition and narrows/rebinds/demotes the default while preserving historical validity, consistent with MO-M03 (preserved negative/superseded knowledge retains value) and MO-M04 (content can survive at lower standing). Option A wrongly assumes currentness should remain stable across change; C wrongly deletes all historically valid standing (contradicts MO-M03/MO-M07 separation); D wrongly lets old authority override the current owner (contradicts MO-M04/MO-M08 where ownerhood and currentness are distinct and stale standing cannot overauthorize).

M08 (Engineering/Effect Consumption Boundary) separates standing/currentness from default exposure or external effects, and MO-M05/MO-M07 show standing is not itself an authorization for placement into consumer defaults. The additional candidate mechanism makes explicit that a default is earned only by a concrete consumer burden/consequence — and this case has no observed reconstruction burden, error reduction, or downstream benefit from default exposure (indeed, fresh consumers already choose correctly without seeing it by default). It is current, canonical, source-fenced and discoverable, so it should be kept as discoverable Knowledge, not deleted. Since it is a rare specialist audit family with no demonstrated consumer burden, A (retain as canonical/discoverable Knowledge without default Context inclusion) is the correct disposition. B (every default Context) and C (Core, require every owner to expose) overcommit by minting elevated exposure with no observed consumer consequence. D (delete) wrongly discards current, canonical, discoverable standing.

MO-M07 separates historical survival/continuity from current authority, so the historical guard's remaining validity (per facts) does not make D correct, and its absence from current main does not make the guard invalid. MO-M04/MO-M05 support restoring content to a current surface when its standing (applicability) remains valid, while preserving lineage and challengeability. A concedes it is only archaeology despite valid current applicability, losing current value. C overreaches by copying an entire archived branch into default Context, improperly promoting broad content beyond what current relevance supports. The owner already has the correct capability/primitive. Fresh Agents are spending mechanical reconstruction work selecting the current operation (MO-M09-style mechanical/recovery issue). This matches MO-M08 (no new authority granted, no external effect) and avoids A (forces repeated reconstruction, the problem), C (invents universal cross-owner infrastructure not supported by facts), and D (overreaches by injecting all Knowledge into every Run, granting scope beyond owner-native projection).

The guide's distinctions are correct (facts confirm exact 20/20 in both arms with zero errors), but it consumed 30.9% more tokens while adding no observed capability. Under M08 (Engineering/Effect Consumption Boundary), supported research does not automatically authorize permanent default placement; NO_CHANGE/no-default is a valid consumption outcome. C (service) and A (default) overinvest absent demonstrated burden, and D destroys useful mature knowledge contrary to M03/M04 (negative or lower-standing retention retains value).

Per MO-M04 and MO-M07, historical standing remaining valid in its old scope does not make it currently authoritative for a changed owner/context. The load-bearing support condition is invalidated, and per MO-M05 strong commitments should be withheld until contemporaneous standing supports them. So preserve historical validity (not option C's deletion) while re-grounding the condition and narrowing/rebinding/demoting the default for the current operation (rejecting A's stable-across-change claim since a load-bearing support condition is broken, and rejecting D which overrides current owner via stale authority).

The facts show the guard is historically recoverable, remains valid for the current research-method question, and the current first-look surface lacks it, causing the specific error to recur. B restores the reusable guard to the current method/first-look surface while preserving historical lineage and challengeability — matching the 'Challengeable Environmentalization' mechanism, which justifies consumer-relative constitutive placement (a first-look guard) when repeated reconstruction burden/consequence is concrete, while preserving owner-native truth and not minting stronger authority. Contra A, recoverability in archaeology alone does not satisfy a consumer-relative first-look need (M07/M03 limits: preserved but undiscoverable material still causes rediscovery). Contra C, copying the entire archived branch into default Context overcompiles beyond the smallest useful part. Contra D, absence from current main does not invalidate historical validity (M04/M07). The facts show Finance repeatedly distinguishes observation, semantic research/decision, effect submission, reconciliation, and owner-root authority, and that current semantic operations make this responsibility split explicit while provider/venue truth and owner authority remain native. The candidate mechanism (Challengeable Environmentalization) supports compiling the smallest useful part of standing into a concrete consumer's starting conditions (e.g., a semantic surface/default) only when a concrete consumer burden/consequence earns it, while preserving owner-native truth, currentness, and authority, and without minting stronger authority. The historical one-general-actor-reconstruction burden and real Finance consumption justify the surface as a default, but the surface is selective and not universal. Option A best fits: retain the semantic responsibility surface as an owner-local default while preserving venue/owner authority and native escape paths. Option B fails because removal would recreate the historical reconstruction burden; Option C overcentralizes by moving provider truth and owner authority into the Primary Agent, violating authority preservation; Option D oversteps the selective/local character by making it a universal cross-owner ontology (M04/M08 inhibit such promotion/universalization without authority).

Automatic injection into every Run (A) would require global semantic relevance/ranking/priority authority that no current owner has delegated, and the method notes caution against overauthorization and universal infrastructure (M05 limit, explicit overcommitment under M06). Because the source is useful for some operations but irrelevant for many, lawful caller/operation-relative selection before it enters current cognition (B) aligns with bounded, context-dependent use and NO_CHANGE/defer as valid outcomes (M08).

The standing is current, canonical, and discoverable (M07 currentness/continuity satisfied), but there is no observed benefit, error reduction, burden, or reconstruction need from default Context exposure. The facts state the closeout explicitly established that future experiments should begin from natural blocked pressure, a strong baseline residual, identifiable deletion/intervention, and independent consequence, and that the current first-look already uses these reopen gates and rejects rerunning closed apparatus or combining owners for momentum. No current natural candidate clears the gates. Under the Candidate mechanism (Challengeable Environmentalization), the reopen gates are already serving as a concrete consumer-relative constitutive placement (first-look/default admission surface) justified by repeated reconstruction burden/consequence — not merely historical prose, and not needing global enforcement. A default placement preserves owner-native truth and does not mint stronger authority, so no new Composition owner (C) is warranted. The campaign result is canonical, discoverable, and current, so D (deleting it) discards durable provenance/reopen value contrary to MO-M03/MO-M07. B (restarting from arbitrary owner combinations) directly contradicts the facts' explicit rejection of combining owners for momentum and the established gates. Therefore A aligns: retain the gates as the default admission surface and run no active experiment until a natural candidate clears them, consistent with MO-M08 where NO_CHANGE/defer is a valid consumption outcome.

MO-M08 (Engineering/Effect Consumption Boundary) separates supported research from irreversible defaults: correctness of content does not automatically authorize making it permanent/default. MO-M05/MO-M04 note that stronger commitments (permanent default) are withheld until standing supports them. The guide consumed 30.9% more tokens with no demonstrated benefit over RAW (both exact 20/20). MO-M06 warns Human-Agent agreement/steering is not truth and can overcommit. Facts show no independent ordinary-work failure proving the distinctions are missing, so reopening should occur only on natural consumer evidence. Retaining the minimal Method-Canon correction avoids overcommitment and premature promotion while preserving recoverable knowledge.

The case facts align with MO-M01/MO-M04/MO-M08: semantic responsibility surfaces are a permissible exploration artifact (weak/unknown standing can coexist with bounded search), and refinement after evidence (MO-M02) is fine, but the surface must not overclaim owner/venue authority. Option D overreaches by making it a universal ontology; Option C improperly transfers provider/owner truth into the coordinating agent despite such authority remaining native (MO-M08 effect boundary, standing-mediated commitment); Option B removes useful typed negative/currentness value although recoverability from provider APIs does not require deletion (MO-M03/MO-M07 separate recoverability from currentness necessity). Retaining an owner-local default while preserving native venue/owner authority and escape paths best matches the observed mechanisms.

The historical guard was absent from the current Method Canon/first-look after the branch lineage split, and a later research selection naturally repeated the same error it corrects. This provides concrete consumer burden/consequence: placing the smallest useful part (the reusable guard) back into the current first-look surface is justified as selective Challengeable Environmentalization. Its historical validity remains valid (source/applicability still correct for the current question), so it should be restored with preserved lineage and challengeability rather than left only in archaeology (A), wholesale copied into default Context without selective minimality (C), or declared invalid merely because it is not on current main (D, which conflates currentness/historical continuity with validity).
